confirmatory_layout.scale_translation: A former 12-branch (4 repeats x 3 arms) or 18-branch (6 repeats x 3 arms) plan becomes 16 or 24 branches; this audit does not choose or run the final sample size.

proposed_fourth_arm.important_limit: No rotation can trigger MinimumTravelHeading without changing a limited-FOV sensor sector. This arm minimizes rather than eliminates additional view coverage.
motion: from arrival heading theta0 rotate to theta0 + alpha
zero-twist dwell only for any remaining Sweep time budget
proposed_fourth_arm.name: A3_minimal_keyscan_oscillation
proposed_fourth_arm.preregistered_success_gate: exactly two post-arrival heading-triggered keyscans, no translation-triggered keyscan, distance/time/raw-scan budget within the already used v10 matching tolerances
proposed_fourth_arm.start_pose_and_route: identical to A1 Dwell through probe arrival

rationale: Four of five net extra edges are directly generated by the two heading-threshold keyscans. Limited FOV means geometry is also real, so a fourth arm is required to separate keyscan creation from the broader Sweep view union.
